formation_states.formation: A battlefield position containing a Force. A Bond and/or Name may also be present.
formation_states.bonded: A Formation containing a Force and a Bond. It may also contain a Name.
formation_states.named: A Formation containing Force + Bond + Name. Every Named Formation is also Bonded.
formation_states.formation_with_name: A Formation containing a Force and a Name but no Bond. It is not Named.
formation_states.prepared_bond: A Bond in a battlefield position with no Force.
formation_states.prepared_name: A Name in a battlefield position with no Force.
formation_states.becomes_named: A Formation becomes Named whenever it changes from not having Force + Bond + Name to having all three. BECOMES NAMED resolves at that transition.
formation_states.bonded_state: BONDED is a state, not a trigger: it is true while a Formation contains Force + Bond.
formation_states.named_state: WHILE NAMED is a state, not a trigger: it is true while a Formation contains Force + Bond + Name.

force.role: Base Strength and one simple battlefield identity.
force.buried_rule: PLAY text may be covered after it resolves. BONDED, WHILE NAMED, and 1/BATTLE effects must be completely readable in the exposed strip.

bond.role: Compact modifier/support in the middle of the stack.
bond.buried_rule: PLAY text may be covered after it resolves. BONDED, WHILE NAMED, and 1/BATTLE effects must be completely readable in the exposed strip.

name.role: The readable top card and main home for persistent, recurring, and formation-completion mechanics.

hero.role: Dual-use Force/Name. Force mode obeys Force grammar; Name mode obeys Name grammar.

stratagem.role: Hidden plan that protects or amplifies your own troops.

narrative.role: Face-up support for your own troops, classifications, and formation states.

classification_vocabulary.human: Broadest people classification. Human support is common but deliberately modest.
classification_vocabulary.ship: Long-range support and unusual Front interaction.
classification_vocabulary.stronghold: Static support, protection, and staying power.
classification_vocabulary.archer: Ranged pressure, Strength reduction, and support from a distance.
classification_vocabulary.guard: Protection, interception, and resistance to hostile Tactics.
classification_vocabulary.scout: Information: hands, hidden Stratagems, and advance knowledge.
classification_vocabulary.rider: The main home for the game's deliberately scarce movement effects.
classification_vocabulary.skirmisher: Harassment, temporary suppression, and small Strength penalties.
classification_vocabulary.raider: Pressure on prepared cards, Command costs, and the opponent's build-up.
classification_vocabulary.spearman: Simple, dependable battlefield Strength, especially in the Front.
classification_vocabulary.king: Command, broad coordination, and high-impact Named payoffs.
classification_vocabulary.captain: Local formation-building, Bonds, Names, and action efficiency.
classification_vocabulary.veteran: Reliability, marker removal, and once-per-Battle resilience.
classification_vocabulary.steward: Command efficiency, card filtering, and resource management.
classification_vocabulary.builder: Bonds, prepared cards, and Stronghold-style development.
classification_vocabulary.heir: Succession and access to King synergies once fully established.

classification_rule: Classifications have no inherent rules. Their identity emerges only because other cards consistently refer to them.

memory_vocabulary.effect_marker: Marks a temporary effect on a formation/card.
memory_vocabulary.suppression_marker: Marks text or Strength that is ignored temporarily.
memory_vocabulary.front_marker: Marks a temporary rule attached to a Front.
memory_vocabulary.face_down_source: The face-down Stratagem itself is the reminder.
memory_vocabulary.face_up_source: The visible Narrative/Name itself is the reminder.

layout_spec.no_lifting_rule: A Named Formation must be fully playable without lifting, sliding, or fanning any card.
layout_spec.command_cost: One unlabeled faceted Command-cost gem in the bottom-right corner. The number is the complete visible cost treatment.

playtest_axes.note: Classification is only one axis. These overlapping design tags exist to expose mechanical coverage and help build deliberately varied playtest decks.

timing_vocabulary.play: Resolve immediately when the card is played.
timing_vocabulary.once_per_battle: A deliberate ability usable once each Battle; mark it used.
timing_vocabulary.bonded: A visible state effect active while the Formation contains Force + Bond.
timing_vocabulary.while_named: A visible state effect active while the Formation contains Force + Bond + Name.
timing_vocabulary.becomes_named: Resolve when the Formation transitions into the Named state.
timing_vocabulary.action: Spend an Action to use this visible Name ability.
timing_vocabulary.trigger: A visible Name reacts to the stated event.
timing_vocabulary.continuous: A visible Name or Narrative rule remains active while its source remains active.
timing_vocabulary.hidden: A face-down Stratagem reveals under its stated condition.
